parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Specifies whether the Interworking element is included in the wireless frames for this access point.

parameters.name: AccessNetworkType
parameters.description: Type of access network to be specified in Interworking element as per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-236 Access Network Type}}.

parameters.name: InternetAvailable
parameters.description: Indicates that Internet Access is available at the AP when set to {{true}}. This MUST be set to {{false}} in case of walled-garden environments, where the AP may limit Wi-Fi access to locally available content. See {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.91}}.

parameters.name: ASRA
parameters.description: Additional Step Required For Access as specified in the Interworking element of {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-484}}. Indicates that the network requires a further step for access when set to {{true}}. The Type of access is determined by {{param|#.ANQP.NetworkAuthTypes}}.

parameters.name: VenueGroup
parameters.description: Specifies the venue group as descriped in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-65-Venue group codes and descriptions}}.

parameters.name: VenueType
parameters.description: Specifies the Venue Type as described in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-66 Venue Type assignments}}.

parameters.name: HESSID
parameters.description: Specifies the 6-octet MAC address that identifies the homogeneous ESS as described in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.91}}.

parameters.name: EmergencyServiceReachable
parameters.description: ESR (emergency services reachable) field of the Interworking element as described in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.91}}.

parameters.name: UnauthenticatedEmergencyServiceAvailable
parameters.description: UESA (unauthenticated emergency service accessible) field of the interworking element as described in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.91}}.

object.description: This object contains the settings to the interworking element as described in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.91}}.
